card.name: Naïve after treatment-type words
card.fires_on: The start of "naïve" (na, Na, -na) after a treatment or drug class, as in treatment-naïve, INSTI-naïve or chemotherapy-naïve. It also fires on the "top" of "top-ups".

modes.description: The first piece of "naïve" after a hyphen or a treatment word, naming patients with no prior therapy.
